children: Hagerty entered into an Underwriting Agreement on September 9, 2026 to facilitate a secondary public offering by a selling stockholder. The underwriters exercised their option in full, bringing total shares sold to 10,637,500 at $11.95 per share, and the offering closed on September 11, 2026. Wells Fargo Securities and J.P. Morgan Securities acted as representatives of the underwriters. The deal supports liquidity for existing holders and broadens Hagerty's public float.
: Underwriting agreement for secondary equity offering
: Wells Fargo Securities and J.P. Morgan Securities, as representatives of the underwriters
: Facilitate secondary equity offering and enhance share liquidity
